product.name: Marriott Bonvoy Bevy American Express Card

benefits.name: Free Night Award after $15,000 spend
benefits.notes: One Free Night Award, redeemable at hotels up to 50,000 points, after $15,000 of purchases in a calendar year. Recorded as a perk rather than an estimated credit because it is conditional on spend — counting it would put roughly $400 into 'available' for a household that will never reach the threshold.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status
benefits.notes: Complimentary Gold Elite status while the card is open, plus 15 Elite Night Credits each calendar year. No dollar value is tracked.
